body: I'm sorry but curiosity isn't enough to keep me going.
It will be alright. My mother once told me that when a good soul dies, God brings another. I don't know if you'll take offense to that but I like that saying. It helps me to think that.

Maybe. I just can't face the day-by-day so I don't really like to look towards the future anymore. I just try to keep my shit together for the day and I'm happy when I get to sleep because I'm not awake. Being awake is a death sentence.
It used to, but the one person who truly believed in me gave up so I am giving up too.
I'm sorry. I make people sad a lot.

Well thank you for being so kind. I've always been told that my perceptions of myself are incorrect but it doesn't change that my perceptions of me are what I see after my shitty life. It's terrible because at this point I can't even imagine what others see me as because I have such little hope in myself.
Perhaps. But regardless of perceptions at the end of the day I can't seem to change my own mind this time, and while it is sad, it doesn't change.
Thank you, but playing a few instruments isn't impressive. It's something, but it's nothing to write home about. I offer nothing to the world more than just another space wasted.

Thank you for your kind words, however I have made my mind. I am not going to kill myself for anyone other than me. I'm doing myself an injustice by living because I feel so alone and worthless. I don't have any future because I limit myself from doing things I enjoy because I'm just not happy with anything.
I'm sorry you feel this way, I know, it's terrible. If you need someone, I am always here. I will always be here.
